# Helper functions

```{r}
extract_ca_mat <- function(pdb, resno_vec, chain_id = "A") {
  sel <- atom.select(pdb, elety = "CA", resno = resno_vec, chain = chain_id)
  if (length(sel$atom) == 0) return(NULL)
  mat <- matrix(pdb$xyz[sel$xyz], ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  colnames(mat) <- c("x", "y", "z")
  rownames(mat) <- as.character(pdb$atom$resno[sel$atom])
  mat
}

```

# ChimeraX-aligned structures (2SRC frame)

```{r}
aligned_pdb_dir <- paste0(data_struct, "anisotropy_aligned")
chimerax_files <- setNames(
  file.path(aligned_pdb_dir, paste0(kinases, "_aligned_chimerax.pdb")),
  kinases
)

missing_files <- chimerax_files[!file.exists(chimerax_files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop("ChimeraX-aligned PDB files not found in ", aligned_pdb_dir, ":\n",
       paste(basename(missing_files), collapse = "\n"),
       "\nRun data/structural/anisotropy_aligned/align_kinases_to_2SRC.cxc in ChimeraX to regenerate them.")
}

aligned_pdbs_cx <- lapply(chimerax_files, read.pdb, rm.alt = TRUE)

aligned_coords <- list()

for (k in kinases) {
  k_map <- struct_feat[kinase == k & !is.na(Pos_al),
                       .(Pos, Pos_al)][order(Pos_al)]

  k_ca      <- extract_ca_mat(aligned_pdbs_cx[[k]], k_map$Pos)
  found_pos <- as.integer(rownames(k_ca))

  dt <- data.table(
    kinase = k,
    Pos    = found_pos,
    x_2src = k_ca[, "x"],
    y_2src = k_ca[, "y"],
    z_2src = k_ca[, "z"]
  )
  dt <- merge(dt, k_map[Pos %in% found_pos], by = "Pos", all.x = TRUE)

  aligned_coords[[k]] <- dt
}

coords_dt <- rbindlist(aligned_coords)
```

# Signed xyz distances to the active site

```{r}
hrd_asp_resno <- 386L
cat_sel <- atom.select(pdb_2src, resno = hrd_asp_resno, elety = c("OD1", "OD2"))
cat_xyz <- matrix(pdb_2src$xyz[cat_sel$xyz], ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

anp_sel <- atom.select(pdb_2src, resid = "ANP")
anp_xyz <- matrix(pdb_2src$xyz[anp_sel$xyz], ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

ref_xyz     <- rbind(cat_xyz, anp_xyz)
anp_centroid <- colMeans(anp_xyz)

min_signed <- function(ca_coord, ref_col) {
  d <- ca_coord - ref_col
  d[which.min(abs(d))]
}

for (k in kinases_all) {
  k_dt <- aligned_coords[[k]]
  k_dt[, dx := mapply(min_signed, x_2src, MoreArgs = list(ref_col = ref_xyz[, 1]))]
  k_dt[, dy := mapply(min_signed, y_2src, MoreArgs = list(ref_col = ref_xyz[, 2]))]
  k_dt[, dz := mapply(min_signed, z_2src, MoreArgs = list(ref_col = ref_xyz[, 3]))]
  aligned_coords[[k]] <- k_dt
}

coords_dt <- rbindlist(aligned_coords)
```


# Directional datasets

```{r}
directions <- list(
  "x+" = list(axis = "dx", sign = +1),
  "x-" = list(axis = "dx", sign = -1),
  "y+" = list(axis = "dy", sign = +1),
  "y-" = list(axis = "dy", sign = -1),
  "z+" = list(axis = "dz", sign = +1),
  "z-" = list(axis = "dz", sign = -1)
)

src_2src_ddga_vars <- copy(ddg_a[kinase == "SRC"])
src_2src_ddga_vars[, kinase := "SRC_2src"]
ddg_a_all <- rbind(ddg_a, src_2src_ddga_vars)

coords_ddga_vars <- merge(
  coords_dt[, .(kinase, Pos, Pos_al, dx, dy, dz)],
  ddg_a_all[, .(kinase, Pos, Pos_al, abs_ddga = abs(`mean_kcal/mol`))],
  by = c("kinase", "Pos", "Pos_al"), all.x = FALSE
)

dir_data <- rbindlist(lapply(names(directions), function(d) {
  info     <- directions[[d]]
  axis_col <- info$axis
  sign_val <- info$sign

  other_cols <- setdiff(c("dx", "dy", "dz"), axis_col)

  sub <- copy(coords_ddga_vars)
  sub[, axis_val := get(axis_col)]
  sub[, orth1    := get(other_cols[1])]
  sub[, orth2    := get(other_cols[2])]

  sub <- sub[sign_val * axis_val > -SIGN_TOL &
             abs(orth1) <= SLAB_THRESH &
             abs(orth2) <= SLAB_THRESH]

  sub[, dist      := abs(axis_val)]
  sub[, direction := d]
  sub[, axis_lab  := gsub("[+-]", "", d)]

  sub[, .(kinase, Pos, Pos_al, direction, axis_lab,
          dist, dx, dy, dz, abs_ddga)]
}))

dir_data[, kinase    := factor(kinase, levels = kinases_all)]
dir_data[, direction := factor(direction,
  levels = c("x+", "x-", "y+", "y-", "z+", "z-"))]

```

# Exponential decay fitting

```{r}
fit_decay_one <- function(data, min_n = 5) {
  if (nrow(data) < min_n || all(is.na(data$abs_ddga))) return(NULL)
  tryCatch({
    fit <- nls(abs_ddga ~ a * exp(b * dist),
               data  = data,
               start = list(a = 0.5, b = -0.05),
               control = nls.control(maxiter = 200, warnOnly = TRUE))
    co    <- coef(fit)
    k_se  <- tryCatch(summary(fit)$coefficients["b", "Std. Error"],
                      error = function(e) NA_real_)
    r2    <- cor(fitted(fit), data$abs_ddga, use = "complete.obs")^2
    d_half <- log(2) / abs(co["b"])
    data.table(a = co["a"], k = co["b"], k_se = k_se,
               d_half = d_half, r2 = r2, n = nrow(data))
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Fit failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })
}

decay_params <- rbindlist(lapply(kinases_all, function(kin) {
  rbindlist(lapply(levels(dir_data$direction), function(d) {
    sub <- dir_data[kinase == kin & direction == d]
    res <- fit_decay_one(sub)
    if (!is.null(res)) {
      res[, `:=`(kinase = kin, direction = d)]
    }
    res
  }), fill = TRUE)
}), fill = TRUE)

decay_params[, kinase    := factor(kinase, levels = kinases_all)]
decay_params[, direction := factor(direction,
  levels = c("x+", "x-", "y+", "y-", "z+", "z-"))]
decay_params[, abs_k     := abs(k)]

```

# Confidence intervals and pairwise comparison

```{r decay_ci_and_comparison}
decay_ci <- copy(decay_params)
decay_ci[, ci_lo := log(2) / (abs(k) + 1.96 * k_se)]
decay_ci[, ci_hi := log(2) / (abs(k) - 1.96 * k_se)]
setorder(decay_ci, kinase, direction)
cat("== d_half with 95% CI (Wald CI on k, transformed) ==\n")
print(decay_ci[, .(kinase, direction,
                   d_half = round(d_half, 1),
                   CI = sprintf("%.1f-%.1f", ci_lo, ci_hi))])

cat("\n== Median d_half per direction (5 kinases, SRC_2src excluded) ==\n")
print(decay_params[kinase %in% kinases, .(median_dhalf = median(d_half, na.rm=TRUE)), by = direction][order(-median_dhalf)])

compare_decay <- function(kin1, dir1, kin2, dir2) {
  r1 <- decay_params[kinase == kin1 & direction == dir1]
  r2 <- decay_params[kinase == kin2 & direction == dir2]
  z  <- (r1$k - r2$k) / sqrt(r1$k_se^2 + r2$k_se^2)
  data.table(
    group1 = sprintf("%s %s", kin1, dir1), d_half1 = round(r1$d_half, 1),
    group2 = sprintf("%s %s", kin2, dir2), d_half2 = round(r2$d_half, 1),
    z = round(z, 2), p_two_sided = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z)))
}

decay_compare <- rbindlist(list(
  compare_decay("FGR",   "z+", "SRC",   "z+"),
  compare_decay("ZAK",   "y+", "MAPK9", "y+"),
  compare_decay("MAPK9", "x-", "ZAK",   "x-")
))
cat("\n== Pairwise z-test on decay constants ==\n")
print(decay_compare)
```

# Fig 4E: directional reach

```{r plot_G2, fig.width=14, fig.height=4, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dev="svg"}
THETA <- 35 * pi / 180
PHI   <- 22 * pi / 180

axis_pad <- 3
arm_lim <- function(dir) {
  ceiling(max(decay_params[direction == dir, d_half], na.rm = TRUE)) + axis_pad
}
lim_xp <- arm_lim("x+"); lim_xm <- arm_lim("x-")
lim_yp <- arm_lim("y+"); lim_ym <- arm_lim("y-")
lim_zp <- arm_lim("z+"); lim_zm <- arm_lim("z-")

proj3d <- function(x, y, z) {
  tmp <- x; x <- -y; y <- tmp
  x <- -x; y <- -y; z <- -z
  x1 <-  cos(THETA) * x + sin(THETA) * y
  y1 <- -sin(THETA) * x + cos(THETA) * y
  sx    <- x1
  sy    <- -sin(PHI) * y1 + cos(PHI) * z
  depth <-  cos(PHI) * y1 + sin(PHI) * z
  data.table(sx = sx, sy = sy, depth = depth)
}

origin_p <- proj3d(0, 0, 0)

seg_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(reach_wide)), function(i) {
  row <- reach_wide[i]
  k   <- as.character(row$kinase)
  ends <- data.table(
    direction = c("x+",     "x-",     "y+",     "y-",     "z+",     "z-"),
    ex        = c(row$xp, -row$xm,       0,        0,        0,        0),
    ey        = c(   0,       0,    row$yp, -row$ym,        0,        0),
    ez        = c(   0,       0,       0,        0,    row$zp, -row$zm)
  )
  ep <- proj3d(ends$ex, ends$ey, ends$ez)
  data.table(
    kinase    = k,
    direction = ends$direction,
    sx1 = origin_p$sx, sy1 = origin_p$sy,
    sx2 = ep$sx,       sy2 = ep$sy,
    depth = ep$depth
  )
})

segs <- rbindlist(seg_list)
segs[, kinase := factor(kinase, levels = kinases_all)]
setorder(segs, -depth)

ax_ends <- list(
  list(ex= lim_xp, ey=0,       ez=0,       label="x+"),
  list(ex=-lim_xm, ey=0,       ez=0,       label="x−"),
  list(ex=0,       ey= lim_yp, ez=0,       label="y+"),
  list(ex=0,       ey=-lim_ym, ez=0,       label="y−"),
  list(ex=0,       ey=0,       ez= lim_zp, label="z+"),
  list(ex=0,       ey=0,       ez=-lim_zm, label="z−")
)

ax_segs <- rbindlist(lapply(ax_ends, function(a) {
  ep <- proj3d(a$ex, a$ey, a$ez)
  data.table(sx1 = origin_p$sx, sy1 = origin_p$sy,
             sx2 = ep$sx,       sy2 = ep$sy)
}))

ax_labels <- rbindlist(lapply(ax_ends, function(a) {
  ep <- proj3d(a$ex * 1.12, a$ey * 1.12, a$ez * 1.12)
  data.table(sx = ep$sx, sy = ep$sy, label = a$label)
}))

tick_len <- 1.5
tick_pos <- c(x = lim_xp, y = lim_yp, z = lim_zp)
tick_neg <- c(x = lim_xm, y = lim_ym, z = lim_zm)

tick_segments <- rbindlist(lapply(c("x", "y", "z"), function(ax) {
  d3 <- switch(ax,
               x = c(1, 0, 0),
               y = c(0, 1, 0),
               z = c(0, 0, 1))
  tv <- c(
    seq(10, floor(tick_pos[[ax]] / 10) * 10, by = 10),
   -seq(10, floor(tick_neg[[ax]] / 10) * 10, by = 10)
  )
  axis_proj <- proj3d(d3[1], d3[2], d3[3])
  dir2d  <- c(axis_proj$sx - origin_p$sx, axis_proj$sy - origin_p$sy)
  dir2d  <- dir2d / sqrt(sum(dir2d^2))
  perp2d <- c(-dir2d[2], dir2d[1])
  rbindlist(lapply(tv, function(t) {
    p <- proj3d(d3[1] * t, d3[2] * t, d3[3] * t)
    data.table(
      sx1 = as.numeric(p$sx) - perp2d[1] * tick_len,
      sy1 = as.numeric(p$sy) - perp2d[2] * tick_len,
      sx2 = as.numeric(p$sx) + perp2d[1] * tick_len,
      sy2 = as.numeric(p$sy) + perp2d[2] * tick_len,
      val = t
    )
  }))
}))

dir_colors_ax <- c(
  "x-" = "#FF8080",
  "x+" = "#CC0000",
  "y-" = "#80AAFF",
  "y+" = "#0047AB",
  "z-" = "gold",
  "z+" = "#ca9e0e"
)

make_kin_plot <- function(k) {
  segs_k <- segs[as.character(kinase) == k]
  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = ax_segs,
                 aes(x = sx1, y = sy1, xend = sx2, yend = sy2),
                 color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "solid") +

    geom_segment(data = segs_k,
                 aes(x = sx1, y = sy1, xend = sx2, yend = sy2,
                     color = direction),
                 linewidth = 2.2, lineend = "butt", linejoin = "mitre", alpha = 1,
                 arrow = arrow(angle = 17, type = "closed", ends = "last",
                               length = unit(0.2, "cm"))) +
    geom_point(aes(x = as.numeric(origin_p$sx), y = as.numeric(origin_p$sy)),
               color = "black", size = 1.2) +
    geom_text(data = ax_labels,
              aes(x = sx, y = sy, label = label),
              size = 4, color = "black", lineheight = 0.85) +
    geom_segment(data = tick_segments,
              aes(x = sx1, y = sy1, xend = sx2, yend = sy2),
              color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +

    scale_color_manual(values = dir_colors_ax, name = "Direction") +
    coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

plots_G2 <- lapply(kinases, make_kin_plot)

p_G2 <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plots_G2, ncol = length(kinases))

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Fig4E_anisotropy_axes.pdf"),
       p_G2, width = 14, height = 5)
```

# ChimeraX: d½ arrows (BILD)

```{r bild_output, message=FALSE}
bild_dir <- paste0(results_path, "00_chimera/anisotropy/")
dir.create(bild_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ARROW_R1  <- 0.4
ARROW_R2  <- 0.9
ARROW_RHO <- 0.75

hex_to_rgb01 <- function(hex) {
  v <- col2rgb(hex) / 255
  sprintf("%.3f %.3f %.3f", v[1,1], v[2,1], v[3,1])
}

ox <- anp_centroid[1]; oy <- anp_centroid[2]; oz <- anp_centroid[3]

dir_names <- c("x+", "x-", "y+", "y-", "z+", "z-")

endpoints_for <- function(row) {
  list(
    xp = c(ox + row$xp, oy,          oz),
    xm = c(ox - row$xm, oy,          oz),
    yp = c(ox,          oy + row$yp, oz),
    ym = c(ox,          oy - row$ym, oz),
    zp = c(ox,          oy,          oz + row$zp),
    zm = c(ox,          oy,          oz - row$zm)
  )
}

kinase_bild_lines <- function(k) {
  row     <- reach_wide[kinase == k]
  col_str <- hex_to_rgb01(kin_colors[[k]])
  d_vals  <- c(row$xp, row$xm, row$yp, row$ym, row$zp, row$zm)
  ep_list <- endpoints_for(row)

  lines <- c(
    sprintf("# Kinase: %s: allosteric reach (d½ per direction)", k),
    sprintf(".color %s", col_str),
    sprintf(".sphere %.2f %.2f %.2f 1.2", ox, oy, oz)
  )
  for (j in seq_along(ep_list)) {
    ep <- ep_list[[j]]
    lines <- c(lines,
      sprintf("# %s  d½ = %.1f Å", dir_names[j], d_vals[j]),
      sprintf(".arrow %.2f %.2f %.2f  %.2f %.2f %.2f  %.2f %.2f %.2f",
              ox, oy, oz, ep[1], ep[2], ep[3],
              ARROW_R1, ARROW_R2, ARROW_RHO)
    )
  }
  lines
}

for (k in kinases_all) {
  lines <- c(
    "# Allosteric reach BILD: open alongside 2SRC or aligned kinase structure in ChimeraX",
    sprintf("# ANP centroid origin: %.2f %.2f %.2f", ox, oy, oz),
    kinase_bild_lines(k)
  )
  path <- file.path(bild_dir, sprintf("%s_allosteric_reach.bild", k))
  writeLines(lines, path)
}

combined_lines <- c(
  "# Allosteric reach (d½): all kinases in 2SRC coordinate frame",
  "# Open alongside aligned_pdbs/2SRC_reference.pdb and axes_2SRC.bild in ChimeraX",
  sprintf("# ANP centroid origin: %.2f %.2f %.2f", ox, oy, oz),
  ""
)
for (k in kinases_all) {
  combined_lines <- c(combined_lines, "", kinase_bild_lines(k))
}
combined_path <- file.path(bild_dir, "allosteric_reach_all_kinases.bild")
writeLines(combined_lines, combined_path)
```
